title: Descent of finite-model quotient cohomology from the chart calculation
statement: Fix $\ell,E,A,R_n$ and the quotient coordinates of [def-sfb-finite-model-quotient-coordinates]. Let $V$ be qcqs and $M$ an integral constant-model constructible module sheaf as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Fix $n\ge0$, a finiteness witness for $R_n$, discreteness for its recorded quotient topology, and a normalized encoding on every scheme. Assume LocalCalculation for this $M,n$ and these encodings: on every specified stratification and covering chart, each exact scalar resolution gives the internal two-term quotient complex with constant finite, finitely presented kernel and cokernel cohomology. Then $H^q(M_n)=0$ whenever $q\ne-1,0$; every $H^q(M_n)$ is internal constant-model constructible; and every encoded $H^q(M_n)$ is intrinsically constructible in the fixed-coefficient sense [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. Boundedness is not part of this conclusion: it is deduced separately in the parent proof.

source.place: Locality and Strata: descent of the local two-term calculation to individual cohomology sheaves.

proof.text: Unpack hM into a finite stratification and pro-etale covering charts. The proved integral_scalar_model_coordinates theorem realizes each internal scalar finite presentation as a finitely presented ordinary module over the integral DVR. The existing scalar_resolution theorem gives a length-one finite free presentation over that DVR. Express its linear map as the original scalar matrix, including zero ranks, and apply the supplied universal chart calculation.

Define the scalar cohomology model of the literal two-term complex to be its matrix kernel in degree -1, its matrix cokernel in degree 0, and the zero module in every other degree. The chart record supplies the two constant cohomology identifications and finiteness. For other degrees the complex has a zero term; exact constant realization and the counit of the specified derived encoding show its cohomology is zero. Exact quotient inverse image commutes with cohomology. Compose these comparisons to identify the encoded pullback of every cohomology sheaf with the displayed finite scalar model, which is zero outside {-1,0}.

Use the proved normalized encoding-pullback comparison to express those chart identifications in ordinary fixed-coefficient sheaves. For q outside {-1,0}, each chart restriction is zero. The adopted generic upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction and isIso_of_isIso_localizationRestriction implement the localized-site restriction comparison and cover-local isomorphism detection, which descend zero to the strata. Constructible strata in a qcqs scheme have compact domains and quasi-compact immersions. Their finite jointly covering family detects zero by the adopted proved module-sheaf detection theorem. The fixed encoding is faithful and reflects zero, so the internal cohomology is zero. The argument allows the empty family on an empty scheme.

Keep the original strata and covers and the finite scalar cohomology models in every degree. They witness ordinary finite-model stratified constructibility. The proved finite-discrete constructibility comparison gives internal constant-model constructibility. Exactness of the encoding identifies encoded internal cohomology with cohomology of the encoded complex. Constant finite models are locally constant and have finite geometric stalks, which gives the intrinsic fixed-module constructibility predicate. If there are no strata, use the existing positive-stratification helper on the empty scheme. No Noetherianity, completeness, or weak-etaleness assumption on the stratum immersions is used.

lean.statement:
theorem cohomology_descent
    (V : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace V] [QuasiSeparatedSpace V]
    (M : AdicCompletion.Modules l E V)
    (hM : IsConstantModelConstructible (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) V M)
    (n : ℕ) (hf : Finite (R l E n))
    (hd : @DiscreteTopology (R l E n) (AdicCompletion.finiteTopology l E (n + 1)))
    (enc : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, Encoding l E n T)
    (hcalc : LocalCalculation l E V M n enc) :
    (∀ q : ℤ, q ≠ -1 → q ≠ 0 →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (reduction l E V M n))) ∧
    (∀ q : ℤ, IsConstantModelConstructible
      (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E (n + 1)) V
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (reduction l E V M n))) ∧
    (letI := hf
     letI := (Padic.coefficientExtensionAbsoluteValue l E).toNormedField
     ∀ q : ℤ, Scheme.IsConstructibleProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf V
       (ULift.{u + 1} (R l E n))
       ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
         ((enc V).fixedDerived.functor.obj (reduction l E V M n))))
